cross_cutting_notes: All three fail the $50/hour test in year one under base cases. Only the TMC guide's bull case and the CRE OM template's bull case clear it.

Two of the three source-level disagreements are inherited: vip.graphics sells the same OM asset at $36/$99/$249 across channels, and the CRE-analyzer price band sits inside a $0-$1,000 ladder, not a market norm.
Every revenue figure descends from one unverified assumption - the 8-10 sales-per-review ratio - which Etsy does not publish. Treat all case numbers as order-of-magnitude, not point estimates.
AI research cost (~400k-500k tokens per opportunity) is recorded as an assumption and deliberately not priced; cost_cents is null.
